summary: Every Access list shows a State column, so problems stand out at a glance.

new.title: State column on Access lists
new.text: Every list under Access now has a State column for accounts and groups, with problems first and in colour. A queued new account is never shown red.

fixes.title: Gone accounts leave the plan
fixes.text: Deleted admins whose account no longer exists are no longer planned to be created again.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: A notice about AD rights for older hybrid installations, reconcile says Left alone, and AD clean-up times show in local time.
